bridge.narrative: Unsloth's June 18 beta tightens exactly the consumer-class loop this thesis expects a hyperscaler to absorb: frontier open-weight coverage (GLM-5.2, Gemma 4 multi-token prediction, DiffusionGemma), an auto-fit memory algorithm worth roughly 3x longer context, Blackwell RTX 50X/60X support, vLLM 0.22+ compatibility, and a parallel mode that chats, trains, exports and runs recipes at once. The fine-tune-to-agent toolchain is maturing into the productizable shape the prediction's structural force assumes.
bridge.remaining_gap: No hyperscaler has wrapped the loop in a managed console with a curated tool catalog and synthetic-data generator; today is open-source maturation, not a service launch.
